title: So You Want to Define a Well-Known URI
summary: Mark Nottingham, a recognized web infrastructure expert and former IETF chair, provides in-depth guidance on designing Well-Known URIs - a standardized HTTP mechanism for resource discovery on the web. The article explores best practices, common pitfalls, and design principles for creating stable and interoperable well-known URI schemes.
problem_solved: Provides authoritative guidance on designing discoverable, stable, and standards-compliant URIs for web resource discovery.
why_valuable: Well-Known URIs are fundamental to web infrastructure but often poorly implemented; this expert guidance helps developers avoid common mistakes in URI design.
